verdict.rationale: There is no documented region or residency selector for the hosted service. However, Omnara documents a free, open-source self-hosted deployment where agent history lives in your own Postgres, which lets a user control where data is stored. missing for 10: hosted region/residency selection, documented data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, explicit docs on where hosted data is stored, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0.
Self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres for analytics, evals, prompt analysis, and training datasets.
